datasets.name: Juliet C/C++ 1.3
datasets.provider: NIST SAMATE / NSA Center for Assured Software
datasets.label_policy: Files can contain paired bad/good portions; use metadata or explicit extraction rather than whole-file heuristic labels.

datasets.name: Juliet C/C++ 1.3.1 with extra support
datasets.provider: NIST SAMATE / NSA Center for Assured Software
datasets.license_note: NIST page identifies the suite and checksum; follow source terms.
datasets.label_policy: Use Juliet-specific bad/good pairing metadata; never infer whole-file labels from CWE path alone.
datasets.acquisition: registry-reference+sha256; explicit download URL required by evaluator

datasets.name: SATE VI Wireshark
datasets.license_note: Preserve the source suite's own terms in the acquisition record.
datasets.label_policy: Patch/CVE/bug-tracker provenance must remain attached to cases.

datasets.name: PrimeVul
datasets.split_policy: Prefer the dataset's project-aware and chronological split metadata; independently run EvidenceLab leakage checks.
datasets.metadata_policy: Prefer v0.1 metadata-rich release; retain project URL, commit URL, CVE/NVD and file_info when present.

datasets.name: SecVulEval
datasets.split_policy: Group by repository/project and preserve CVE/patch context; do not randomly mix near-identical revisions across evaluation partitions.

datasets.name: DiverseVul
datasets.split_policy: Prefer project-aware and chronological evaluation; never use CWE metadata alone as the vulnerability label.
datasets.source_note: Research release reports 18,945 vulnerable and 330,492 non-vulnerable functions from 7,514 commits across 150 CWEs.
